word_count_method: Whitespace-delimited words, including title, caption, command and URLs.
review: Writer self-check only; no detector testing or publication.

claims.DTC1: Preserved: ETag validates reuse of a stored response.
claims.DTC2: Preserved: server supplies ETag; client sends it in If-None-Match on a later conditional GET.
claims.DTC3: Preserved: selected-representation match returns bodyless 304 and permits stored-body reuse; otherwise successful GET scope explicit.
claims.DTC4: Preserved: nonmatching tag returns current JSON with 200 within successful GET scope.
claims.DTC5: Preserved: conditional validation requires a request.
claims.DTC6: Preserved: illustrative freshness policy permits reuse without validation, subject to other caching rules.
claims.DTC7: Preserved: freshness does not guarantee unchanged underlying data for 60 seconds.

claims.AX1: Preserved: repeatable reader-focused editing, fact preservation, flow and review; comparison optional without guarantee.
claims.AX2: Preserved: one reply, email or documentation section; editing and measurement remain separate.
claims.AX3: Preserved: exact standalone installation command, agent selection and current-project default.
claims.AX4: Preserved: original text, audience, purpose, technical question, documentation and version constraints.
claims.AX5: Preserved: editing prompt requires readability, facts/code/qualifications, removal of repetition/background, explained corrections and separate review of exact final text.
claims.AX6: Preserved: prerequisite, pronoun and repetition examples with a meaning check.
claims.AX7: Updated as expressly required: compare explanatory prose separately from code, retain inline values, preserve measurement records and adverse results, and separately review code/full-message correctness. Update is explicitly distinguished from historical study scope.
claims.AX8: Preserved: own detector access and supported browser required; neither supplied; correctness/readability assessed separately.
claims.AX9: Preserved: saved Qwen Code pair, fresh September 6, 2026 recheck, Basic Scan Model 4.9b and exact confidence triplets.
claims.AX10: Preserved: screenshots show completed historical recheck, not article scores or a new packaged-skill test.
claims.AX11: Preserved: sole intervention is a short relevant asker quotation; answer body unchanged; content and length both changed; rewriting benefit not established.
claims.AX12: Preserved: mixed is not human confidence; lower AI confidence does not establish human authorship.
claims.AX13: Preserved: dated development sample only, 5 of 10 quotation reductions and 0 of 15 plain-rewrite reductions.
claims.AX14: Preserved: separate LLM reviewers, eight clearer/seven equivalent, explicitly not human preference ratings.
claims.AX15: Preserved: completed UI observations; current packaged skill still lacks prospective validation for reliable detector performance.
claims.AX16: Preserved: quotations must help answer; clear correct edits can remain useful with unchanged scores, subject to publication requirements.
claims.AX17: Preserved: try a draft, share successes/failures, repository contents and both exact destination URLs.
claims.AX18: Preserved: complete before/after caption with Qwen body/quotation, native confidence triplets, mode/model/date, genuine panels and partial inputs, full-input repository link location and content/length change.

files.protected_literals: All preserved byte-for-byte; installation command remains an independent standalone line.
files.cuts_or_corrections: No claim cuts or technical corrections. AX7 is the supplied user-authorized instruction update; historical results retain their original scope.
